name: coach
description: ADHD-friendly productivity coaching: daily planning (/today, /energy), end-of-day capture (/checkin), weekly scheduling (/plan-week) and review (/weekly), life-direction reviews (/review), goal-to-project alignment (/align), project lifecycle (/intake, /breakdown, /reentry, /sunset), idea capture (/spark), brain dump (/dump), task triage (/triage), decision journaling (/decide), and pattern analysis (momentum, overdue-rescue) with adaptive tone calibration

interface.longDescription: Daily and weekly planning, end-of-day capture, life-direction reviews, goal-to-project alignment, project lifecycle (intake through sunset), idea capture, brain dumps, task triage, decision journaling, and pattern analysis, with tone calibrated to energy level.
